why: loc_sts_bls_ina_05 is Militech's immigrant detention center on Coachwhip Ln. in the Jackson Plains, at the Night City-SoCal border: a walled compound with a main gate, a parking gate, a security system and a guard yard, used by Gig: Goodbye, Night City. Vanilla instantiates its street-story prefab only from the gig's own phases, so the clean slate leaves the compound with no garrison. This proposal restores the two vanilla whole-community activations that make it a working facility: the Militech garrison (rangers, an officer, snipers, security troopers, two Wyvern drones and two technicians on tablet, cigarette, patrol and repair spots) and the group of detained refugees in the yard. Bruce Welby, Archibald Crane, the extraction car, the alarm response and the gig's reinforcements are left out. Venue-node-policy section 1: omit quest detainees and gig-specific occupants from static population. Owner tour 2026-11-27: gig-staged robots and drones are off under the quest-units rule (venue-node-policy section 5); human staff and guards remain.

open_questions: Posture is partly unresolved: the catalogue has no community area node for either spawner (spots 0), so the entry-to-spot map is missing. Guard A_spawn poses read relaxed from the workspot names, but guard_005/guard_008/guard_012 have no spot in the extracted sector; and the refugee pool contains a 'dead' and a q110 'hurt' workspot, so the tour must confirm A_spawn does not seat a corpse or wounded civilian. If it does, drop #ina_05_refugees_com.

The catalogue's wiki pages (Belly of the Beast, Forward to Death, We Gotta Live Together) are a false match via the shared q114_nomad_community phase; the real pages for this venue are Militech Detention Center and Gig: Goodbye, Night City in the same local corpus.

Does #sts_bls_ina_05_streetstory alone make the compound read as intact? If the detention block geometry lives in the excluded #sts_bls_ina_101_streetstory, part of the interior may look bare; that prefab carries another gig's force and a named prisoner, so it was not declared.

The anchor #ina_05_main_gate lives in loc_sts_bls_ina_05_gameplay_prefabKYKES7A. If that section is not streamed without a quest, the proximity wait never fires and the venue relies on its boot activation only; the tour should watch for the second activation.

Refs for #ina_05_gate_parking, #ina_05_gates*, #ina_05_parking_door and #ina_05_reinforcements_001_com are unresolved paths in the catalogue (venue_inferred), so their positions and existence are unverified.
